extracted.name: Grandma's Blueberry Buckle
extracted.description: Grandma's blueberry buckle recipe is baked in a 9x13-inch dish and features a delicious, tender berry-filled cake topped with a buttery cinnamon crumble.
ingredient_lines: 0.66666668653488 cup cold butter, cut into cubes
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Beat 1 ½ cups sugar and ½ cup softened butter together in a large bowl using an electric mixer until creamy and smooth. Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Whisk 4 cups flour, baking powder, and salt together in a separate bowl until well combined; stir into egg mixture, alternating with milk, until just combined. Fold in blueberries until evenly distributed. Pour batter into the prepared baking dish.
Combine 1 ⅓ cups sugar, 1 cup flour, and cinnamon in a medium bowl; cut in ⅔ cup cold butter using a pastry blender or 2 knives until crumbly. Sprinkle topping evenly over batter.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, 40 to 45 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.
